sharedProfiles.name: Humber Light Reconnaissance Car Mk III

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Scout, Artillery Spotter, Air Spotter (4+), Assault Troops, Behind Enemy Lines, Unique

characteristics.name: Payload (Single Use)
characteristics.$text:
2x large bombs or
4x small bombs or
8x 5" rockets

rules.name: Machine Gun Dug-out
rules.description: 3 men and a Vickers HMG in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the MG team move.

rules.name: Sniper Hideout
rules.description: A single sniper in reinforced cover. It can be placed anywhere outside of the opponent’s deployment zone. The cover is lost if the sniper moves.

rules.name: Mortar Pit
rules.description: 3 men and a 3-inch mortar in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the mortar team moves.

rules.name: Artillery Observation Post
rules.description: A Forward Observer Team in reinforced cover.  The cover is lost if the observer team move.

rules.name: Off-table 17-pdr Anti-Tank Shot
rules.description: The positions are covered by 17 pdr anti-tank guns well-camouflaged behind the lines. You may take a single 17 pdr Aimed Fire – Armour-Piercing shot at an enemy vehicle within 30" of your table edge. The shot will hit on a dice roll of 6, with a penetration value of 8. This requires no orders to use.
